info.title: AgentHub synthetic memory integration
info.description: AgentHub合成数据原生自动记忆接入。真实聊天完成后提交完整实际userInput/agentResponse，复用底层记忆模块 raw/semantic/episodic/procedural异步提取。派生内容与逐字核验Fact分开；自动应用须automaticExtraction=true。未知写入只读恢复不重放。业务侧原生删除、授权撤回、注销清理本期返回501，不产生成功清理回执；后台逐条遗忘属于独立管理接口，见management.md。 Business-service routes only; delegated administration routes are documented in management.md.

post.description: Built-in MCP endpoint for agent-autonomous memory (spec 2026-11-11-memory-mcp): JSON-RPC methods initialize / tools/list / tools/call. Auth: Bearer agent runtime token + X-Agent-Capability (HMAC-signed per-agent capability armed at deploy time). Tools: memory_remember / memory_recall / memory_list / memory_update. Scope is server-pinned to {tenant, hub-agent, agent:<name>, agent-memory-v1}; identity never travels in tool arguments. See docs/memory/README.md (Agent autonomous memory section) for the full contract, env vars (MEMORY_MCP_URL / MEMORY_CAPABILITY_SECRET / AGENT_MEMORY_WRAPPING_KEY) and deployment notes.

200.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response (tool results and errors are HTTP 200 with embedded isError)

javaService.description: Per-application trusted Java service credential. Never expose to App.

tenantMemoryManager.description: 独立租户级服务端管理令牌。固定tenant与Hub委托；应用令牌不能调用这些端点。

userText.description: The complete actual synthetic user message; must exactly equal quote.

profile.description: Exact newline join of the active facts named by profileFactIds; no generated summary.

content.description: Actual user edit relayed by trusted Java.

taskId.description: Empty when no pending candidates; an empty task is not persisted.

physicalCleanup.description: Meaningful only within cleanupScope for a supported legacy cleanup action; current native integration never claims physical erase.

cleanupScope.description: Legacy cleanup scope; empty for an operation without a cleanup contract. Not returned for native unsupported actions.

ledgerRetained.description: True while Hub ciphertext evidence remains. Logical native correction retains old raw text and is not a physical-cleanup operation.

Operation.description: Business operation receipt. Cleanup fields are retained for legacy KB schema compatibility. Native unsupported delete/revoke/deactivate actions return Error/501 and never create or return this receipt. Native activation and other accepted non-cleanup operations do not imply erasure.

reason.description: Stable domain reason. MEMORY_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED accompanies HTTP 501 for native delete/revoke/deactivate.

BackendCapabilities.description: Per-application feature policy shared by Java service capabilities and flattened Hub admin application metadata.

backend.description: Authenticated application backend; not selected by an API request.

rawOnly.description: True for the native RAW-only Memory adapter.

correctionSupported.description: Manual Hub ledger CAS editing. False for automatic-extraction applications; submit a new actual corrective conversation instead.

forgetSupported.description: False for the current native integration.

physicalDeleteSupported.description: False for the current native integration.

consentRevokeSupported.description: False for the current native integration; a rejected request makes no ledger changes.

deactivateSupported.description: False for the current native integration; no lifecycle freeze or erasure is performed.

automaticExtractionSupported.description: Configured native conversation extraction interface; verify provider and worker separately.

conversationCorrectionsSupported.description: Natural-language correction may be ingested as a new actual conversation; does not guarantee disabling contradictory historical derived messages.

nativeMaxContextChars.description: Native automatic-context budget. Positive for automatic-extraction applications; separate from legacy ledger context limits.

nativeDefaultMessages.description: Native automatic-context budget. Positive for automatic-extraction applications; separate from legacy ledger context limits.

nativeMaxMessages.description: Native automatic-context budget. Positive for automatic-extraction applications; separate from legacy ledger context limits.

nativeStatusSupported.description: Availability of this native administration capability for the configured application; admin routes require a delegated Hub manager JWT.

nativeDiagnosticsSupported.description: Availability of this native administration capability for the configured application; admin routes require a delegated Hub manager JWT.

nativeForgetSupported.description: Whether delegated administrators can forget individual native records through the separate management API. This does not enable business-side deletion or physical cleanup.

Capabilities.description: Query this before choosing actions. Native capabilities are policy declarations; they do not replace live storage/provider acceptance.

maxFactsPerContext.description: Legacy quote-verified ledger context limit; use native budget fields for /native-context.

invalidAt.description: Native associated/event end time, preserved as data; ended events remain retrievable.

status.description: Effective Hub supply state, including parent and forget checks.

nativeStatus.description: Record's own native enable switch, distinct from effective Hub supply state.

parentStatus.description: Effective RAW parent state; omitted for RAW records.

statusChangeAllowed.description: Whether native status management is allowed; false for forgotten targets or parents.

forgottenAt.description: Native per-record forget marker. The record is excluded from normal retrieval; content may remain available to managers.

parentForgottenAt.description: Forget marker of the source original. Hub blocks derived supply without marking this child individually forgotten.

NativeContext.description: Most recent two valid raw sources are prioritized, followed by retrieval hits. Whole-record content budget 4000 Unicode code points. Historical derived conflicts may remain.
